audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 and the 2+ items row were both given to Fiora, contradicting their own why text on this page, the packet chart, and the mirror (fiora__ornn), which already shipped win[2]=Skill and win[6]=Ornn.
audit.why: Level 3 is where Bellows Breath arrives and the trade math evens out. At two items Fiora still wins the isolated duel, but the stage belongs to Ornn: Masterwork upgrades plus a self-comboed knockup chain decide 5v5s she cannot parry her way out of.
audit.corrected: Both rows flipped in matched full/content pairs, ratings moved with them, and the full-layer whys rewritten to state the reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why and phases[6].why were boilerplate and named no spike.
audit.why: The level-3 spike is Bellows Breath; the two-item stage is Living Forge's Masterwork upgrades against Grand Challenge's 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Riposte interaction was stated as 'parries + stuns your knockup' with no cooldown and no sequencing. Duelist's Dance's heal and move speed, Grand Challenge's team heal, and Lunge applying on-hit effects were all absent.
audit.why: Riposte parries all incoming damage for its window and only stuns if it blocked an immobilising effect — so the knockup is precisely the thing not to feed it, and it is 24s at rank 1, which is a long punish window. Duelist's Dance heals her whenever a vital is struck, and Grand Challenge heals her and nearby allies if she completes all four or the target dies — both are Grievous Wounds cases. Lunge applies on-hit effects, so her damage is not read by armour alone.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and all three dontsFull bodies now carry Riposte's 24s and its stun condition, Lunge's 13s and on-hit, and both healing sources.

edits.after: Bellows Breath is online — unstoppable percent-HP poke and a shield she cannot parry off you, so trades go even.

edits.after: Her vitals still beat your armour 1v1, but Masterwork upgrades and a self-comboed knockup chain win you every 5v5.

edits.after: - Riposte: 24s at rank 1 — it parries all damage, and if it blocks your knockup she stuns you. Commit after it. - Lunge: 13s at rank 1, applies on-hit. - Grand Challenge: 110s and it heals her.

edits.after: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 and stuns you if it blocks the knockup — bait it first.

edits.after: Vitals rotate around her target, so keep moving and turning — a stationary Ornn hands her a free heal and move speed.

edits.before: That is Fiora's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Fiora, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.

notes: Left in place, unverified: the page repeatedly says her vitals deal percent-max-health TRUE damage. Riot's Duelist's Dance text in the kit file describes only the heal and the move speed and carries no trueDamage flag (that flag sits on Grand Challenge), so I neither strengthened nor removed the claim — but it should be checked before it is repeated elsewhere. Same treatment for the existing claim that Bellows Breath's shield 'cannot be parried off you'; parry eligibility is not in the kit data.
